applies_to: Belimo VAV-Universal controllers VRU-D3-BAC, VRU-M1-BAC and VRU-M1R-BAC used for VAV/CAV airflow, duct pressure and room pressure control.
summary: The VAV-Universal VRU is a damper controller with an integrated differential pressure sensor that is paired with a separate actuator. The damper manufacturer selects the application (flow control, pressure control, room pressure control or flow measurement), and the AO 1 setpoint is interpreted to match. Over BACnet MS/TP it reports airflow, differential pressure, position and status, and accepts setpoint, limits and override commands.
notes: Which objects are in service depends on the application in MV 2; airflow objects are out of service in pressure applications and vice versa.
MV 2 ApplicationSel and MV 100 ControlMode are read-only over BACnet; they are set by the damper manufacturer.
Room pressure control and MV 102 OperationMode apply to the VRU-M1R-BAC only.
MI 103 has no access marking in the document; it is listed as read-only.
The sensor input S1 is not available while the room pressure cascade (MV 10) is enabled.

integration.summary: SpSource defaults to Bus, so the BMS can command AO 1 SpRel straight away; it is interpreted as flow, pressure or position per the factory-set application and is scaled between Min and Max. Read airflow or differential pressure plus BI 101 for alarms. If the bus watchdog is enabled, keep writing AO 1 or MO 1 inside the timeout.

minimum_points.name: ApplicationSel
minimum_points.why: Confirms how the setpoint is interpreted

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource = 2 (Bus, default) makes AO 1 the active setpoint; Analog uses the signal on wire 3, and then the watchdog only tracks MO 1.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 BusWatchdog, 0-3600 s, 0 = disabled. Writes to AO 1 or MO 1 reset the timer; on timeout their priority arrays are cleared and the relinquish defaults apply, and MI 110 shows Bus watchdog triggered.
integration.remote_sensors: Sensor 1 can be read when MV 220 is Active (0-10 V) or Passive (resistance) in AI 20, or Switch in BI 20. With the room pressure cascade enabled, S1 becomes the 0-10 V cascade input instead.
setup: MS/TP only: baud 9600-115200, default 38400; MAC address 0-127, default 1; max 32 nodes without repeater.
AV 120 SystemAltitude (0-3000 m above sea level) is writable; set it to the installed altitude.
gotchas: Writable objects with instance 90 and above are persistent; do not write them on a regular basis.
Min cannot be set above Max, and Max is limited to 20-100%.
Airflow-not-reached is flagged after 600 s and pressure-not-reached after 180 s.
